visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a cream-colored cable-knit sweater stands on a city sidewalk in front of a line of yellow rental bicycles. He gestures enthusiastically toward the bicycles while speaking to the camera. The background consists of a storefront with a yellow sign and blurred urban street elements under a bright, overcast sky. (2) The camera zooms in as the man points to a specific bicycle where the seat has been rotated 180 degrees to face backward. He looks confused, touching the seat with his right hand while leaning in to examine it. Text overlays in yellow and black appear on the screen. (3) A second man with black hair and a grey button-down shirt enters the frame from the right. He looks serious and begins gesturing toward the bicycle seat, explaining something with a focused facial expression. The first man reacts with exaggerated surprise, opening his mouth wide and squinting his eyes. (4) The scene shifts to close-ups of the bicycle's handlebars and seat as more dramatic text overlays in purple and gold appear. The two men are now both visible, reacting with high energy and shock. The street background remains consistent with passing cars and scooters blurred in the distance. (5) A third man wearing a white long-sleeve shirt appears behind the second man, tapping him on the shoulder. He looks very intense, staring directly into the lens and yelling. The other two men look startled. The camera uses quick cuts between the characters' faces to emphasize their reactions. (6) The camera focuses on the wire basket of one of the bicycles, which contains a crumpled brown paper bag from McDonald's and a used tissue. The men stand in the background, looking disappointed and making exaggerated 'disgusted' faces. Purple lightning-like graphics emanate from the basket to highlight the trash. (7) All three men stand together on the sidewalk, looking directly at the camera. A graphic appears at the bottom showing a green icon of a person throwing trash into a bin. They smile and nod as large text captions summarize the message of the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic J-pop music with a driving synthesizer beat begins. A male speaker introduces the video in Japanese with a fast, upbeat, and high-energy delivery. The background noise floor includes faint city traffic hums. (2) A sharp 'sting' sound effect plays as the speaker notices the bike seat. His voice becomes theatrical and inquisitive. The music stays bright but drops slightly in volume to allow for clear conversational speech. (3) A second male voice enters, speaking in a deeper, more serious tone as if narrating a mystery. A 'whoosh' sound transition occurs. The music maintains its fast tempo, adding rhythmic percussion hits for comedic timing. (4) Loud shouting occurs as the characters express surprise. The speech rate is hyper-dense. Multiple 'cartoon' impact SFX play in quick succession to match the flashing text on the screen. The music's spectral brightness is high. (5) A third male speaker joins with an explosive, high-arousal yelling style. The music reaches a peak intensity. The voices overlap frequently in a rhythmic, scripted comedy pattern. Background traffic noise remains low and non-interfering. (6) The tone shifts to one of comedic anger. The third speaker yells directly at the audience with high vocal tension. Impact and 'glitch' SFX are used to emphasize his points about trash. (7) The music swells into a final major-key chord. All three voices speak in unison with high positive valence and excitement. A soft 'ding' SFX marks the final graphic, and the music fades quickly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate viewers on YouBike etiquette in Taiwan (turning the seat backward to signify a mechanical issue) while comedically criticizing those who leave trash in bike baskets, utilizing a high-energy skit format.
